events.title: Beautify & Boogie
events.description:
Hey girls, get ready for four hours of nonstop jams from the ’60s, ’70s, ’80s, ’90s, and 2000s at Beautify & Boogie, a feel-good dance party for all women to hit the dance floor, celebrate our community, and support a cleaner, greener, more beautiful Akron!

We’re bringing the music, the memories, and the dance floor fun, all wrapped up before bedtime!

Join Keep Akron Beau
